findings.description: The V2 contract changes code/test review paths to V2 but retains resume_preconditions.both_reviews_must_be_PASS_and_bind_sha256=9cef921c... (the V7 proposal hash). Its new review_binding_rule instead requires both current reviews to bind the exact V2 contract bytes, SHA3411e430.... These are contradictory authoritative binding requirements for the same reviews. The executor enforces the new contract binding in review_receipt, while line273 repurposes the legacy both_reviews... field as a V7 source-proposal binding. That interpretation is not what the field declares.
